title: Pacific Palisades Farmers Market Gather Again Press Briefing 8/19/2026
description:
A beloved Pacific Palisades tradition is finally home. 

After temporarily relocating following the Palisades Fire, the Pacific Palisades Farmers Market has returned to its longtime home on Swarthmore Avenue at Palisades Village. For more than 25 years, the market has brought neighbors together while supporting local farmers, vendors and small businesses.

Councilwoman Traci Park joined community leaders, business owners and residents to celebrate the reopening—an important milestone in the community’s ongoing recovery. With businesses reopening, families rebuilding and familiar gathering places returning, Pacific Palisades continues to move forward.

Every visit and purchase helps strengthen local businesses and supports the recovery of this resilient community.
